==Overview==
=== Format ===
* 16 teams participate
** 10 teams in Group Ascend
** 6 teams in Group Nirvana
* Double Round Robin within Group Ascend
* Single Round Robin within Group Nirvana
* Matches are best of three
** Matches use "Hard Fearless Draft", champions can only be picked once by either team during the series
** Side selection for game 1 is decided by a 1v1 match
*** A player can't play two 1v1 match consecutively.
* Top 4 of Group Ascend directly qualify for the [[LPL/2025 Season/Split 2 Playoffs|Playoffs Bracket Stage]]
* Bottom 6 of Group Ascend and Top 2 of Group Nirvana qualify for the [[LPL/2025 Season/Split 2 Playoffs|Playoffs Play-in]]
* Bottom 2 of Group Nirvana are eliminated from LPL 2025, they will play in the  [[LDL/2025 Season/Split 2 Round 2|LDL Split 2]]
* {{TiebreakerRules|
:* If two teams have the same number of series won, ties will be broken by:
::# Game Differential
::# Head to Head record}}
